name: 0v3rw0rk3d 31f

proposedCapabilities.kind: ids.ts Restriction + engine (ContinuousAbility.restrictions aura, activateAbility guard)
proposedCapabilities.spec: Add a Restriction member `cannotUseAbilities`: while a card carries it (statically or via a continuous `restrictions` aura selector), no player may activate that card's activated abilities - `activateAbility`/`perform` rejects the attempt. Triggered, continuous and replacement abilities on the card are unaffected (they are not 'used'). Cleared like any other restriction when the source leaves play or its condition drops. 0v3rw0rk3d 31f grants it as an aura with selector {type:'location'} (unqualified - every location, both players).
proposedCapabilities.why: 0v3rw0rk3d 31f - 'Abilities on locations cannot be used.' `suppressAllAbilities` over-reaches (it also kills triggered/continuous/replacement text on every location, e.g. structure/ETB abilities); no existing Restriction blocks only activation. CR 502/603.2b: 'use an ability' means an activated ability.

notes: Structure debuff can push a location's structure below its accumulated damage -> destroyed by SBA (RULES.md 11, CR 408.5). Icon paragraph is a continuous, active only while the 6x [E] threshold is met (CR 405.4).

proposedCapabilities.spec: Add a `mode:'splitTopBottom'` (or `partialBottom:true`) option to `lookAndReorder`. Pauses for `chooser` to look at the top `count` cards of `player`'s deck, assign each to a 'top' pile or a 'bottom' pile, and order within each pile; the bottom pile goes under the deck, the top pile stays on top, both in the chosen order. Degenerates gracefully if the deck holds fewer than `count`. Existing player/chooser/count semantics unchanged.
proposedCapabilities.why: Ignatius Gloamspike (both abilities) - 'look at the top 2 cards ... put any number on the bottom in any order ... the remaining cards on the top in any order.' `lookAndReorder` today is all-to-top OR all-to-bottom; it cannot split. Also needed by Obsessive Compulsion and the wider 'scry N, bottom any number' family.

notes: Second ability reorders the opponent's deck (player = ownerOf the damaged faction, chooser = controller) then the controller draws. For damageDealt, sourceIsDamageSource is the correct self-scope (not sourceIsEventCard).
